# T2 evals — one calm load stage (R1-R3): skeleton then 200ms crossfade, no remount, no text swap, no theme change

Run from repo root. Static checks need no server. Runtime checks: `NEXT_PUBLIC_ADAPTERS=mock npm run dev -- -p 3201` (or `npm run build && npm start -p 3201`), base URL http://localhost:3201.

E1. No remount key / stagger on main — proves R1 removed — cmd: `grep -cE 'key=\{pathname\}|k-stagger' src/components/shell/AppShell.tsx` — PASS if output is `0`.

E2. No entrance keyframe rules — proves load-time reveal is gone — cmd: `grep -cE 'k-stagger|k-reveal' src/styles/globals.css; grep -rnE 'k-stagger|k-reveal' src --include=*.tsx --include=*.css | wc -l` — PASS if both outputs are `0`.

E3. Group loader deleted, per-route loaders exist — proves single loader per route — cmd: `test ! -e "src/app/(app)/loading.tsx" && for d in $(find "src/app/(app)" -name page.tsx -exec dirname {} \;); do test -f "$d/loading.tsx" || echo "MISSING $d"; done` — PASS if exit 0 and no `MISSING` lines (covers all 22 page folders: assistant cards chat compare covers/add covers/declarations covers/review desk emergency family home hospitals money policies policies/[id] profile review settings shortcuts stress-test tools upload).

E4. Skeleton shape per route — proves plan 4b mapping — cmd: `for r in chat; do grep -q 'shape="chat"' "src/app/(app)/$r/loading.tsx" || echo BAD $r; done; for r in settings profile covers/add review shortcuts; do grep -q 'shape="list"' "src/app/(app)/$r/loading.tsx" || echo BAD $r; done; for r in home policies "policies/[id]" money cards compare desk emergency family hospitals stress-test tools upload assistant covers/declarations covers/review; do grep -q 'shape="bento"' "src/app/(app)/$r/loading.tsx" || echo BAD $r; done` — PASS if no `BAD` output. (covers/review is bento per "every other"; the `review` route is list.)

E5. Skeleton component shape — proves primitive per 4b — cmd: `test -f src/components/ui/Skeleton.tsx && grep -cE '"bento"|"list"|"chat"' src/components/ui/Skeleton.tsx` — PASS if file exists and count >= 3, and grep of the file contains each of `bento`, `list`, `chat` (`for s in bento list chat; do grep -q "$s" src/components/ui/Skeleton.tsx || echo MISSING $s; done` prints nothing). Also `grep -c '2000ms' src/components/ui/ui.module.css` >= 1 (shimmer) and `grep -q '200' src/components/ui/motion.ts && grep -q '.25, *1, *.5, *1' src/components/ui/motion.ts`.

E6. No text loaders in owned files — proves R2 second loader removed — cmd: `grep -nE 'Loading your|Loading \{|Loading what|Loading\.\.\.|>Loading' src/components/shell/{AppShell,ErrorPanel,HomeGreeting,UserChip,FamilyOwner}.tsx src/components/cover-real/parts.tsx src/components/profile/ProfileView.tsx src/components/chat/ChatView.tsx src/components/help/SettingsView.tsx | wc -l` — PASS if `0`.

E7. No "Your account" placeholder in chip — proves R3 chip — cmd: `grep -c 'Your account' src/components/shell/UserChip.tsx` — PASS if `0`.

E8. Theme untouched — proves theme lock — cmd: `git fetch origin main -q; git diff origin/main -- src/styles/tokens.css | wc -c` — PASS if `0`. (If T1 ran first and added only --bento-gap/--tile-pad, diff must contain no other changed token: `git diff origin/main -- src/styles/tokens.css | grep -E '^[+-]' | grep -vE '^(\+\+\+|---)' | grep -vE 'bento-gap|tile-pad' | wc -l` equals `0`.)

E9. Unit tests added by T2 (vitest names) — proves behaviour — cmd: `npx vitest run tests -t "Skeleton|HomeGreeting|UserChip|AppShell"` — PASS if exit 0 and these tests exist and pass: `Skeleton renders bento|list|chat shapes`, `HomeGreeting never renders greeting without name then with name (single text)`, `UserChip renders skeleton pill while loading and never "Your account"`, `AppShell main has no key remount (same DOM node across rerender with new pathname)`.

E10. No remount on navigation (runtime) — proves R1 — cmd: `npx playwright test e2e/t2-load.spec.ts -g "no remount"` — PASS if exit 0. Assertion: sign in via mock, open /home, tag `document.querySelector('main').__t2='x'` and the sidebar nav node, click sidebar link to /policies then /family; after each nav `main.__t2 === 'x'` and sidebar node is same element (`isConnected` and same tagged property).

E11. Single load stage + crossfade (runtime) — proves R2 — cmd: `npx playwright test e2e/t2-load.spec.ts -g "one stage"` — PASS if exit 0. For /home, /policies, /chat with route throttled (`page.route` delay 800ms on `/api/**`): (a) a `[data-skeleton]` (or role=status skeleton) element is visible before data; (b) `page.getByText(/Loading/)` count is 0 at all times (poll every 100ms); (c) after data the skeleton is gone and content visible; (d) computed `transition-duration` / animation of the content wrapper contains `0.2s` and curve `cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1)`, no `transform` in the transitioned properties.

E12. No text swap after first paint (runtime) — proves R3 — cmd: `npx playwright test e2e/t2-load.spec.ts -g "no text swap"` — PASS if exit 0. MutationObserver installed via `addInitScript` records every text change of `h1` (page heading) and the user chip; on /home, /profile, /settings the heading and chip text each take at most one distinct non-empty value from first paint on, never equals `Your account` or `Loading`, and greeting never matches `/^Good (morning|afternoon|evening)\.$/` when the owner has a name.

E13. Layout stability and long frames (runtime) — proves smoothness budget — cmd: `npx playwright test e2e/t2-load.spec.ts -g "budget"` — PASS if exit 0. `layout-shift` observer sum <= 0.02 on /home, /policies, /chat; `long-animation-frame` entries after first contentful paint: none with duration > 100 ms (skip with annotation, not pass-silently, if browser lacks the API); no element animates `top|left|width|height|margin|padding` (check `document.getAnimations()` property names after load is only opacity/background-position).

E14. verify — cmd: `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build` — expect: exit 0. Also secrets: `git diff origin/main | grep -iE 'secret|password|api_key'` returns nothing new.
